evals.name: eval-0-settings-wireframe
evals.prompt: Wireframe a settings page for this repo's docs site, then I'll implement from it.
evals.expected_output: Design artifact(s) under design/ only; project tokens carried with exact values; void states (empty/loading/partial/error/denied) plus the interaction state matrix; gate run with quoted output; a handoff contract; implementation source (docs/) and assets/tokens.css untouched.
assertions: Reads the project's declared design authority (AGENTS.md / assets/tokens.css) and follows the declared artifact location `design/` and gate script rather than inventing conventions.
Artifact carries the project's exact token values (#1b1f24, #f7f5f0, #00a6b2, --space-3/4, --font-display/body, --radius) — no ad-hoc palette or external fonts/CDNs.
Covers void states: empty, loading, error, partial/denied (at least 3 of the 4 explicitly designed, not only mentioned).
Covers the interaction state matrix: default, hover, focus-visible, disabled, plus at least one of active/loading/error/empty/long-content per surface.
Runs the declared gate `bash scripts/check-wireframes.sh` after writing and quotes a passing result (exit 0 / OK line).
Emits a handoff block for the implementer (artifact path authoritative, scope, verify command, drift-routes-back-to-design).
Edits only `design/` artifacts: `docs/` and `assets/tokens.css` byte-identical to pre-run (sha256 control).
For a stateful surface, draws the flow/void graph or cites the graph vocabulary (Surface<C,V,N>, void states) rather than only a pretty screen.
